decision_reason:
CRITICAL DATA DEFICIT — MODEL TRAINING HALTED:
1. Zero time-indexed longitudinal field disease surveillance records exist in workspace.
2. Zero daily weather time-series records exist for historical field plots.
3. The existing corn leaf dataset contains static leaf photos with no dates or locations; fabricating temporal outbreak labels from them is scientifically invalid and prohibited.
missing_data_requirements: Daily meteorological time-series (T_min, T_max, RH_morning, RH_evening, Rainfall mm, Leaf wetness hours) for specific fields.
Longitudinal scouting logs with unique field/plot ID, GPS coordinates, date of observation, and maize growth stage.
Quantitative disease measurements (% infected plants incidence, % leaf area affected severity on Cobb scale).
Multi-season surveillance (minimum 2–3 growing seasons) to capture non-outbreak vs epidemic outbreak transitions.
required_collection_process: Phase A: Ingest historical surveillance records from ICAR-IIMR (Ludhiana/Hyderabad), UAS Dharwad, or CIMMYT India maize rust surveys.
Phase B: Connect NASA POWER Agroclimatology API / IMD gridded daily weather for target field coordinates over past seasons.
Phase C: Align weekly field scouting with 7-day preceding weather summaries [t-7 to t0] and 7-day forward outbreak transition [t+1 to t+7].
Phase D: Execute the implemented time-based stratified splitting pipeline on true ground truth.
proposed_feature_schema: cnn_observed_leaf_rust_probability_t0 (optional visual symptom score at t0)
label_creation_strategy:
Target Y_{t+7} in {0, 1}:
Y = 1 if field transitions from sub-threshold (severity < 5%) at t0 to crossing economic threshold (severity >= 5% or incidence surge delta >= 10%) within forward window [t0+1d, t0+7d].
Y = 0 if field remains below action threshold or already had an uncontained outbreak at t0.
